item.tib: rgyal rigs sras 'khrungs sum brgya'i sgra skad bsgyur / bod yul gnas su rgyud gsum mdzod la dbang / g.yung drung bon la bslab gsum rnam par dag / gsang gsum mdzod lnga'i mdo sngags pandi ta / mdo 'bum legs bshad gzungs sngags zab mo
item.note: the final text in this section was translated into smrar yig by the zhang-zhung abbot gyer-spungs, and translated into tibetan by the tibetan translator rma.
